blocks.text: Washington, United States—US President Donald Trump said in a brief statement Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to halt strikes on each other’s energy infrastructure. “Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the war between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!” he wrote on his Truth Social network, without further details. READ: Lung surgery for Pope Leo XIV to remove localized nodule There was no immediate confirmation from Ukraine or Russia on an agreement, which follows an escalation in deadly attacks in the war.
